items.title: Full GTA 6 Map Leaked Online From Collector's Box
items.summary: Images of the full printed Leonida map from the Collector's Box, claimed to come from a Selfridges employee, are circulating online and show previously unknown areas.

items.title: Palworld Dev Gives All Employees a GTA 6 Holiday Lasting Five Days
items.summary: Pocketpair has given every employee five days of special leave to play GTA 6 when it launches on November 19.

items.title: GTA 6 Unlocks At Midnight On November 19, But Millions Of Americans Can Start Playing The Night Before
items.summary: Forbes breaks down US unlock times by time zone, showing western regions can start playing on the evening of November 18.

items.title: Kick's GTA 6 Promotion is Giving Away 'Thousands of Free Copies'
items.summary: Kick is giving away thousands of free GTA 6 codes to viewers who scan a QR code on its promo truck or watch streams for three hours.

items.title: GTA 6 Surpasses $1 Billion in Presales a Week Before Launch
items.summary: Sensor Tower data reportedly shows GTA 6 has passed $1 billion in pre-launch revenue, with an estimated 10.31 million copies sold.

items.title: Dataminers found AMD FSR 4.1 files in the GTA 6 Xbox preload
items.summary: Windows Central says the files turned up in the Xbox preload, but Rockstar hasn't commented and the outlet doesn't expect FSR 4.1 on day one.

items.title: GTA 6 fans convinced iconic GTA 4 character's cameo has been revealed
items.summary: Fans think GTA 4's Tony Prince appears in Rockstar's newest nightclub-themed clip, based on his look and voice.

items.title: GTA 6 Gets Its First Unboxing Video As Shipping Begins For Xbox & PS5
items.summary: The first physical-edition unboxing, for PS5, shows a download code, an Ultimate Edition code and a double-sided poster.

items.title: Unreal GTA 6 First-Person Clip Posted by Rockstar Games on Instagram
items.summary: Rockstar posted a short first-person in-game clip of the West Coast Customs car lineup on Instagram, and many viewers took it for an AI-generated or real-life video.

items.title: GTA 6 Lead Says Future Games Could Take Place Outside Of America, But Likely Won't
items.summary: Rockstar North co-studio head Rob Nelson told The Guardian "never say never" about a non-US setting, but said there is still much to do in America.
